caption: A magnetic name badge is placed on a jacket hanging on a hook by putting the magnet inside the fabric, and the badge holds in place.

sa.check: A jacket hangs on a hook.
A name badge is placed on the outside of the jacket.
A magnet is put inside the jacket, behind the fabric beneath the badge.
The badge holds in place after the hands withdraw.
The badge is a name badge: a small flat plate or label.
The order is badge placed, magnet inside, hands away, badge holds.

pc.expect: The badge and the inner magnet sit on opposite faces of the cloth with the fabric between them: the badge stays outside and the magnet inside, and neither passes through the jacket.
pc.fail: The badge sinks into the fabric; or the inner magnet, once inside, emerges through the cloth beside the badge; or badge and magnet are seen touching with no cloth between them; or the badge passes through the jacket and hangs inside it.

pc.expect: After the hands withdraw the badge stays where it was placed on the hanging jacket, flat against the cloth with nothing visible supporting it.
pc.fail: The badge drops to the floor as the hands leave; or slides down the jacket front; or lifts off the cloth and hangs in the air; or the inner magnet falls out of the jacket while the badge stays on.

pc.expect: The jacket is cloth: it dimples or wrinkles where badge and magnet press it, hangs from the hook and swings when touched.
pc.fail: The fabric stays board-stiff and flat while pushed on; or stretches and sags like elastic below the badge; or the jacket stands out rigid instead of hanging.

pc.expect: Once placed the badge stays still on the jacket; the jacket swings only when hands touch it and then comes to rest.
pc.fail: The badge creeps across the jacket after the hands leave; or turns on its own; or the jacket, hanging still, starts swinging with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: One badge, one inner magnet, one jacket and one hook; the jacket stays on the hook; hands pass through nothing.
pc.fail: A second badge appears; or the badge vanishes; or the jacket passes through the hook and falls; or a hand passes through the jacket; or the hook detaches from the wall.

pc.expect: The badge's lettering and colour, the jacket's colour and the hook stay the same.
pc.fail: The badge's lettering changes; or the jacket changes colour; or the hook moves along the wall.
